summary: iOS names terminal creation failures, preserves action error banners across feed recovery, makes short terminal owner IDs searchable in Resources and folder pickers, and offers issuer-bound in-place re-pairing in Release.

replay.detail: Phone presentation and pairing changes only; no daemon replay or recovery trigger changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or phone profile format change. Resource search adds optional device-local search text without migrating stored rows.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire protocol, capability, or pairing scope changes. Release re-pairing now uses the saved URL directly and refuses another selected Fabric member; Fabric-only pairing requires the owning node and service. Existing terminals show searchable short IDs because the current inventory omits display names. No additional per-row requests are introduced. Device and mixed-version pairing have not been exercised for this change.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required; this is an app update only.

manual.detail: App update only; no migration or re-pairing is required for existing installations. The new Fleet entry is optional when a person chooses to replace their pairing.

recovery.detail: No new rollback procedure or irreversible migration. Failed or cancelled replacement retains the previous profile; successful replacement saves its matching credential and gateway together using the existing SecureStore commit boundary.
